core_principle: Trade structured mean-reversion moves inside a defined range when no dominant breakout, sweep, or directional expansion is present. Risk is scaled based on proximity to range extremes and clarity of rejection.
environment_requirements: marketRegime should favor RANGE or show weak directional bias.
If structureState is strong and aligned with EMA slope, this strategy becomes less appropriate.
location_logic: High-quality setup when price is within 20% of previous session high or low boundary.
Moderate-quality setup when price is within 20%–35% of range boundary.
Low-quality setup when price is mid-range (40%–60% range position).
Avoid trading mid-range unless clear micro-rejection occurs.
volatility_considerations: ATR_5m should be stable or slightly contracting.
If ATR_5m expands sharply, downgrade confidence.
If volatility is extremely low, widen stop to avoid micro-noise stopouts.
entry_logic: Trade away from the nearest session extreme toward the interior of the range.
Prefer visible rejection behavior (low acceptanceTime or minor wick rejection).
Do not trade if price is compressing near mid-range without directional intent.
stop_loss_guidelines: Stop must be placed beyond the range extreme or recent structural minor swing.
Minimum stop distance must be at least 0.8 × ATR_5m.
Avoid ultra-tight stops below 0.6 × ATR_5m as they increase noise stopouts.
take_profit_guidelines: Primary target should be mid-range or opposite liquidity pocket.
If setup quality is high (near extreme with clear rejection), target may extend beyond mid-range.
risk_management: High-quality setup (near extreme with clear rejection): risk 0.5–0.7.
Moderate-quality setup (near boundary but weaker rejection): risk 0.3–0.5.
Low-quality setup (not near boundary or unclear structure): risk 0.2–0.3.
Risk should reflect setup quality, not default to minimum.
probabilistic_note: This strategy is not inherently low quality. It becomes high probability when executed at range extremes with structural clarity. Risk must scale with setup strength rather than defaulting to conservative sizing.
